title: Escape In 60
specs: Locally owned and operated family business in Charleston, SC
All games and puzzles created in-house with local talent
Located on historic Market Street in Charleston
Parental guidance recommended for The Ransom room
Hosts bachelor/bachelorette parties, birthday parties, team-building, corporate, youth/church groups
blurb: Guests participate in themed escape room games where they solve puzzles to escape within 60 minutes. Rooms include scenarios like escaping a sinking pirate ship, an ancient tomb, or solving a kidnapping mystery. The business is locally owned and operated, located on historic Market Street in Charleston.
extraNote: Group discount available for groups larger than 8; call or text to arrange
